about: Per signal: the model years in which the OBDb command applies (filter), is still being debugged (dbg, dbgfilter), is supported and has a recorded reply in OBDb's own tests. Derived from the OBDb vehicle repositories (CC BY-SA 4.0).
yearFilterSemantics: OBDb/.schemas python/can/signals.py Filter.matches: from<to is an inclusive range; from>=to means year>=from or year<=to; a lone to or from is open-ended; years[] adds single years. dbgfilter uses the same object.

odometerModules.note: Distances are converted to kilometres with the unit each definition declares before they are compared. Pairs of modules, in one model year, that both have at least 3 recorded odometer values. "tracking": at least 3 values of the pair agree within max(50 km, 0.2 %) and at least half of the smaller list does. Recorded cases of different commands may come from different cars, so this shows that two definitions read the same kind of number, not that two modules of one car agree.

note: recordedYears: model years with at least one recorded reply for the signal in tests/test_cases/<year>/commands. supportedYears: command_support.yaml lists the signal. verifiedYears: applicable years that are not debug years.
